title: ESP32-simple_http_server: a simple HTTP server for UART messages
description: An ESP32 program that joins a Wi-Fi network and serves, over HTTP, the last message received on its UART. Written in C with ESP-IDF and FreeRTOS, in VS Code with PlatformIO, at the Universidade de Brasília with Prof. Jones Yudi Mori Alves da Silva.

contributors.name: Mori Alves da Silva, Jones Yudi
